analogy.rationale: Beta amyloid neurotoxicity inhibitors target APP processing but the nine cell lines are non-neuronal and express little APP-related neuronal machinery, so transcriptional response should be minimal; gamma secretase inhibitors share APP pathway but also act on Notch and may show weak effects, while neuroprotective/anti-inflammatory classes are only loosely related.
